title: RSIHub: A Composable Framework for Agent-Evolution Methods
abstract: arXiv:2610.32253v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agent-evolution methods use execution feedback to improve prompts, skills, tools, and orchestration, but their implementations often rebuild the same experimental machinery. We present RSIHub, an open-source framework for building, comparing, and extending these methods on shared infrastructure. Recipes compose reusable operators and declare mutable resources; RSIHub supplies execution, evaluation, recovery, and lineage. Researchers can focus on evolution policy while evaluation stays outside the mutable surface and results remain tied to candidates and evaluation conditions. We instantiate AHE, Hyperagents, A-Evolve, and GEPA without modifying the framework core, keeping method-specific logic in recipes and operators. We evaluate them with MiniSWE and Codex on Terminal Bench 2 and $\tau^3$ Banking under fixed model and evaluator configurations. translated_title: RSIHub：一个面向智能体演化方法的可组合框架
translated_abstract: 智能体演化方法利用执行反馈来改进提示词、技能、工具和编排，但它们的实现往往需要重复构建相同的实验机制。我们提出了RSIHub，一个用于在共享基础设施上构建、比较和扩展这些方法的开源框架。配方组合可复用的算子并声明可变资源；RSIHub提供执行、评估、恢复和谱系追踪功能。研究人员可以专注于演化策略，同时评估保持在可变表面之外，结果与候选方案和评估条件保持绑定。我们在不修改框架核心的情况下实例化了AHE、Hyperagents、A-Evolve和GEPA，将方法特定的逻辑保留在配方和算子中。我们在固定的模型和评估器配置下，使用MiniSWE和Codex在Terminal Bench 2和τ³ Banking上对这些方法进行评估。观察到的最大整体pass@1提升为13.5个百分点，而方法排名则随条件变化。
tldr: RSIHub是一个开源可组合框架，通过共享基础设施统一支持AHE、Hyperagents、A-Evolve和GEPA等智能体演化方法的构建、比较与扩展，无需修改框架核心即可实现，最高可带来13.5个百分点的pass@1提升。
en_tdlr: RSIHub is an open-source composable framework that enables building, comparing, and extending agent-evolution methods (AHE, Hyperagents, A-Evolve, GEPA) on shared infrastructure without modifying the framework core, achieving up to 13.5 percentage points improvement in overall pass@1.
